ValidationRule.description: Because the changes from Salesforce doesnt flow through to CMS, once its integrated with CustomerId, Sales team is not allowed to edit the customer records
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: $Permission.GoldenCopy = false && $Profile.Name != 'System Administrator' && $Profile.Name != 'API Only' && CustomerID__c != '' && ( ISChanged( Name ) || ISChanged (BillingAddress) || IsChanged(VATNumber__c) || IsChanged(CustomerID__c) || IsChanged(ParentId) || IsChanged(Customer_Number__c) || IsChanged(CompanyRegistrationNumber__c) || IsChanged(Phone) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Cannot edit a customer once its integrated with CMS. Any changes has to be done in CMS, and it will reflect the next day.
